headlines.title: 报道：美国考虑设立类似FINRA的监管机构，来审查顶尖AI模型
headlines.summary: 在硅谷领袖抱怨美国近期为放缓尖端AI系统发布而采取的措施过于随意后，特朗普政府正在考虑一项计划，拟在业界的参与下，设立一个独立监管机构来审查人工智能模型的安全性。据知情人士透露，财政部长斯科特·贝森特协助制定了该提案。该提案将创建一个向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）汇报的独立AI监管机构，其模式类似于金融业监管局（FINRA）。该计划目前正由白宫幕僚长Susie Wiles进行审查。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Report: US Considering FINRA-like Regulator to Review Top AI Models
headlines.summary_en: Following complaints from Silicon Valley leaders that US efforts to slow the release of advanced AI systems have been too arbitrary, the Trump administration is considering a plan to create an independent regulatory agency, with industry input, to review AI model safety. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has helped draft the proposal, which would establish an independent AI regulator reporting to the SEC, modeled on FINRA. The plan is currently under review by White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. (Bloomberg).

headlines.title_en: AI Series Events Debut at World AI Conference in Shanghai Under Theme 'Wisdom Leads New Journey, Integration Creates Future'
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV, the Cross-Strait AI Integration and Development Innovation Forum was held on the morning of July 18 at the Shanghai World Expo Center. Under the framework of the 2026 World AI Conference, the forum and accompanying exhibition, organized by the Cross-Strait Economic, Science and Technology Cooperation Center, were held in Shanghai under the theme 'AI Leads New Horizons, Integration Creates the Future.' Jointly organized with the Lin-gang Special Area Administration, relevant Tsinghua University departments, and the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers' Association, the event brought together about 150 representatives. Eight authoritative guests from both sides discussed AI empowerment in manufacturing and healthcare, building a high-level dialogue platform. The exhibition area gathered over 20 Taiwan-invested tech companies including MediaTek and Foxconn Industrial Internet, showcasing AI chips, intelligent driving, the metaverse, and other cutting-edge technologies. The Lin-gang Special Area concurrently promoted industrial support policies. This event opened up cross-strait tech exchanges.

headlines.title: 工信部原副部长王江平：建议加大对优质人工智能终端消费的补贴
headlines.summary: “引导高质量的应用，促进消费升级，要探索跨行业、跨领域的合作，促进人工智能终端在智能制造、智慧教育、文旅、视听等领域的垂类示范作用。依托智能化分级等标准体系，加大对优质人工智能终端产品消费的补贴，引导、鼓励消费者采购人工智能终端优品、名品，提高公众的认知度和接受度。”7月17日，2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC2026）开幕，在“人工智能终端产业演进与协同发展”论坛上，全国政协委员、工业和信息化部原副部长王江平围绕“人工智能终端”提出上述建议，他认为，当前正是人工智能终端发展浪潮的一个关键的窗口期，业界人士应该要抓住机遇。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Former Vice Minister of MIIT Wang Jiangping Suggests Increasing Subsidies for Premium AI Consumer Terminals
headlines.summary_en: 'To guide high-quality applications and promote consumption upgrades, we should explore cross-industry and cross-sector cooperation, promoting the vertical demonstration role of AI terminals in areas such as intelligent manufacturing, smart education, cultural tourism, and audiovisual. Leveraging standard systems like intelligence grading, we should increase subsidies for high-quality AI terminal product consumption, guiding and encouraging consumers to purchase excellent and renowned AI terminal products, raising public awareness and acceptance.' On July 17, at the opening of the 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC 2026), Wang Jiangping, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and former Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, made the above suggestion at the 'AI Terminal Industry Evolution and Collaborative Development' forum. He believes the current period is a critical window for the wave of AI terminal development, and industry players should seize the opportunity. (The Paper)

headlines.title_en: After 11 Years, Consumption Tax Reimposed on Lithium Batteries and Other Products; Experts: Guide New Energy Manufacturing to High Quality at Fair Prices; Insiders: Drive Industry Cleanup and Structural Optimization
headlines.summary_en: [After 11 years, consumption tax on lithium batteries and other products is reinstated; Experts: Guide new energy manufacturing towards high quality and fair pricing; Industry insiders: Drive industry consolidation and structural optimization.] Lu Jinbiao, an expert consultant for the China Photovoltaic Industry Association, said the new policy mainly aims to guide new energy manufacturing away from low-price competition, towards high quality and fair pricing. Consumption tax is an in-price tax, paid by production/processing/import companies during production, commissioned processing, or import stages. Including battery products under the consumption tax mainly reflects a promotion of energy conservation and environmental protection.

headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title_en: National Power Load May Exceed 1.6 Billion Kilowatts; New Grid Construction and Green Power Expansion Accelerate
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, July 18 - Since the start of the 'dog days,' persistent high temperatures have swept across many parts of China. The National Energy Administration previously estimated that the national maximum power load in 2026 will be between 1.575 billion and 1.6 billion kilowatts, possibly exceeding 1.6 billion kilowatts if widespread extreme heat occurs. The industry expects national total electricity consumption in 2026 to grow 5% to 6% year-on-year, with an overall balanced supply-demand situation, though locally tight in summer. Leveraging trillion-yuan grid investments in the '15th Five-Year Plan,' China's new power system construction is accelerating. Experts point out that new energy consumption and energy storage construction remain core to the transition, requiring short-term support from thermal and nuclear power alongside long-term coordinated market policies to secure the foundation for full-year power supply.
